groups.defect: The team permission check uses && instead of OR semantics, denying non-owner team admins.
groups.rationale: All four report the same authorization expression and resulting denial.

groups.defect: Case-sensitive guest comparisons allow both duplicate attendees and blacklist bypasses.
groups.rationale: s_b8b58cda explicitly reports both defects, linking the duplicate-attendee finding to the blacklist findings. The merged comment must preserve both checks.

groups.defect: Duplicate attendees can be inserted through repeated emails within one request and through concurrent requests racing between the existence check and insertion.
groups.rationale: Both schema findings report missing within-request uniqueness; s_c8acf696 also explicitly reports the concurrency race described by s_6180295c. These overlapping findings require preserving both defects.

groups.defect: Passing raw guests instead of uniqueGuests to sendAddGuestsEmails misclassifies existing attendees as newly added guests.
groups.rationale: All four identify the same argument at the same call site and the same incorrect email selection.

groups.defect: The organizer lookup throws an unhandled error for null booking.userId and redundantly queries a user already included with the booking.
groups.rationale: Both report the null-organizer failure from findFirstOrThrow with an ID of zero. s_bfda6ce2 additionally flags the unnecessary database round trip.

groups.defect: The error-message template literal is always truthy, making the generic toast fallback unreachable.
groups.rationale: All three report the same dead fallback expression; the code-prefix examples describe its resulting output.
